tasks.title: Inventory Data Integration
tasks.description: Develop ETL processes to combine and import inventory databases from three faculties into a unified structure, requiring manual duplicate resolution.

tasks.title: Secure Web Interface Development
tasks.description: Implement a secure web interface for accessing the unified inventory and managing assets based on user roles.

tasks.title: Asset and Reservation Workflow Implementation
tasks.description: Build the request/reservation engine ensuring administrator approval workflows, time zone compliance, and non-overlapping reservation checks.

tasks.title: Testing and Release
tasks.description: Execute user acceptance testing and release activities within the eight-week delivery constraint.

acceptance_criteria.given: a room has a confirmed reservation from 10:00 to 12:00
acceptance_criteria.when: a user attempts to reserve the same room from 11:00 to 13:00
acceptance_criteria.then: the system rejects the reservation request

source.quote: A room cannot have overlapping confirmed reservations.

acceptance_criteria.when: the reservation end time is before the start time in Europe/Kyiv

source.quote: Start and end times use the Europe/Kyiv time zone and the end must be later than the start.

acceptance_criteria.when: the owning faculty administrator has not yet reviewed the request

source.quote: Every room reservation requires approval by the owning faculty administrator before confirmation.

acceptance_criteria.then: the request is visible with a rejected status

source.quote: A rejected request remains visible to its requester with a rejected status.
The Product Owner is accountable for specification acceptance and user acceptance testing.
The Business Analyst is responsible for preparing the specification.
The Full-stack Developer is accountable for implementation and deployment.
The Full-stack Developer makes technical implementation decisions, develops the application, and deploys releases.
The QA Engineer is accountable for test execution.
The QA Engineer prepares and executes tests, records defects, and reports whether the release meets the agreed acceptance criteria.
A faculty inventory representative explains asset request and space reservation workflows and participates in user acceptance testing.
